_about: SDG targets used to tag roles, skills and learning-path steps (Domain 1: main SDG 4, target 4.4; related 8.2, 8.5). Target wording is paraphrased; see the UN pages for the official text. The mapping and rationales are the team's declared judgment, not external evidence.

targets.title: Increase the number of youth and adults with relevant skills for employment and decent jobs
targets.rationale: Qart.ai builds job-relevant review and analysis skills for employees whose work is changing with AI.

targets.title: Higher economic productivity through diversification, technological upgrading and innovation
targets.rationale: Employees who can review AI output let a company adopt AI safely, which is technological upgrading.

targets.title: Full and productive employment and decent work for all
targets.rationale: Retraining existing staff into new internal roles keeps people employed instead of replaced.

recon_associate.rationale: Today's role: training here keeps an at-risk role employable (8.5) through new skills (4.4).

ai_finops_analyst.rationale: A role AI creates: reviewing AI work (8.2), reached by retraining current staff (4.4, 8.5).

controls_assurance_analyst.rationale: Designing controls for AI-assisted processes supports safe technological upgrading (8.2).

fpa_analyst.rationale: An analysis role reachable by redeployment from transaction work (8.5).

recon_to_source.rationale: Core technical skill for finance employment.

duplicate_detection.rationale: Core technical skill for finance employment.

cutoff_timing.rationale: Core technical skill for finance employment.

unsupported_adjustment.rationale: Catching unsupported AI adjustments makes AI adoption safe.

fx_conversion.rationale: Core technical skill for finance employment.

transposition_check.rationale: Core technical skill for finance employment.

escalation_judgment.rationale: Judgment is the part of the job that stays human: it protects decent work.

ai_output_review.rationale: The new skill AI adoption needs (technological upgrading).

variance_analysis.rationale: Analysis skill that opens analyst roles.

data_quality.rationale: Trustworthy data is a precondition for productive AI use.

controls_design.rationale: Controls let a company upgrade processes with AI safely.

stakeholder_communication.rationale: Transferable skill that supports moving into new roles.

forecasting.rationale: Analysis skill that opens planning roles.

sql_basics.rationale: Digital data skill for technological upgrading.
